Our Legacy About Us Empowering Africa's tech innovators from humble beginnings to a premier ICT development center. Company History Established in 2018 as a modest computer learning room, Mfano Africa ICT Hub was born out of a vision to resolve the tech talent deficit in Africa. Today, we stand as a premier technology developer, incubating groundbreaking open-source software and producing TVET-certified technicians. Achievements We have successfully trained over 5,200 software engineers and IT security experts with an active 92.4% graduate career transition rate . Partnerships We have built powerful channels with leading local tech enterprises and global tech giants. Invest or Become a Partner Community Impact We hold quarterly free digital literacy bootcamps in underserved counties and provide fully-funded educational scholarships to promising students from underprivileged families.
